audits.purpose: Revisit the six Part95 waste-wood/co-incinerator permit-only scopes using current official permit and company identity evidence plus a bounded target-year PI numeric retrieval attempt.
audits.numeric_policy: No explicit 2024 Air annual-mass Pollution Inventory substance row was retrieved for any of the six facilities, therefore zero numeric candidate rows are created.
audits.permit_limit_policy: Emission limit values, permit concentrations, waste tonnage, APR summaries and monitoring conditions are never substituted for annual Pollution Inventory mass.
audits.direct_raw_policy: The official 2024 PI dataset and active ZIP resource were revalidated. One bounded direct-resource fetch retry failed; the same failed transport path will not be looped. Direct official facility-row count remains zero.
audits.identity_policy: Every facility has current official EA permit/operator evidence and an independently checked Companies House legal entity identifier before fail-closed classification.
audits.zero_policy: Missing or unretrieved PI values remain no-data and are never represented as zero.
